subject: MAP Launch: cadence, owners, and success criteria — kickoff
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@avasys.com>, product@avasys.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP Launch: cadence, owners, and success criteria — kickoff

Hi Liam / Ava product team,

Thanks again for the demo last week — excited about the potential fit. Per our conversation, I'm kicking off a short mutual action plan (MAP) to align on evaluation milestones and a tight close timeline so we can move to a pilot.

Suggested kickoff items:
- Weekly checkpoints (30m) — Tuesdays 9:30am PT, starting 2026-06-09
- Primary owners: Ava product (Liam) — feature validation; Redwood (Jonas/Marissa) — environment + eval support
- Success criteria (draft): latency < 200ms p95 on 256-token bursts; qualitative: 4/5 on relevance in 50 eval prompts; integration: retrieval end-to-end proof of concept
- Close target: pilot PO by 2026-07-07 if success criteria met

I've attached a first-draft MAP workbook (Redwood_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx) with a simple tracker: milestones, owners, blockers, and acceptance criteria. Please review and propose any edits to cadence/owners before our first checkpoint.

Action requested before next Tuesday:
1) Liam: confirm owners for feature validation + data access (who on your side will validate the model outputs?)
2) Procurement: confirm required contracting timeline (cc'd) and if the PO path needs additional approvals
3) Redwood (Marissa/Ben): confirm we can provide a test environment with metric collection and an initial 100k token trial by 6/16

If the Tuesday cadence doesn't work, propose an alternate 30m window and we'll adjust.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB), SLA_Primer.pdf (pdf, 48KB)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@avasys.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: product@avasys.com, Procurement <procure@avasys.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Launch: cadence, owners, and success criteria — kickoff

Thanks Jonas — this looks good. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Owners: I'll own feature validation with support from Priya Mathew (cc'd via product alias) for dataset access.
- Contracting: Procurement flagged that we need to route any pilot T&Cs through legal; typical turnaround is ~10 business days once the SOW is agreed.
- Success criteria: we agree on the quantitative targets but would like an additional qualitative checkpoint: "no more than 10% of responses require manual correction in user-facing flows" — can that be added to the workbook?

We can do Tue 9:30am PT starting 6/9 — Liam confirmed. I'll invite the owning engineers to the weekly recurring once we finalize the MAP sheet.

Liam
Liam O'Connor
Director of Product, Ava Systems
liam.oconnor@avasys.com | +1 (617) 222-3344

I've attached the updated MAP and a short SLA primer for procurement to review. If anyone prefers a different tracker format (Confluence/Hippo), say so and we'll mirror it.

Thanks,
Jonas
